steps_rotate-image_1Desc: Select an image to rotate or flip. The preview shows your current image orientation. All transformations are non-destructive to your original file.
steps_rotate-image_2Desc: Click to rotate 90°, 180°, or 270°. Use flip horizontal or vertical for mirror effects. Preview updates with each click so you can see the result immediately.
steps_rotate-image_3Desc: Click the rotation button to finalize. Download the correctly oriented image — no more sideways photos in your gallery or presentations.
